scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Seung-chan discovering Hye-joo is dating Joon-mo, Joon-mo ending things with Hye-joo, Seung-chan lending Cindy a lobby umbrella, and Ye-jin fuming over her car repair bill.
scenes.location: KBS broadcasting centre and Seoul street

scenes.title: I Hate Going to Work
scenes.summary: In a vivid nightmare shaped like a television counseling show, Seung-chan confesses his tangled office secret before Joon-mo and Ye-jin appear in the studio audience and he wakes up dreading work.
scenes.location: dream television studio and Seung-chan's bedroom

scenes.title: A Chicken Instead of a Pheasant
scenes.summary: Seung-chan begs the documentary cameraman to edit out his earlier personal remarks, then explains on his morning commute why his struggling team must cast realistic guests instead of top stars.

scenes.title: Stay Out of My Private Life
scenes.summary: While fixing the apartment door, Joon-mo remarks that most women call men over for small repairs, sparking an argument with Ye-jin over dating habits and living under someone else's roof.

scenes.title: Why Cannot This Be Processed?
scenes.summary: Tae-ho argues with a colleague when his neighborhood receipts are rejected under corporate card rules, begs to clear just one small snack bill, and hears Il-yong question his menu choice.

scenes.title: Who Are the New Members?
scenes.summary: Reporter Kang corners Joon-mo in the lobby, guesses that top hosts turned down the new season, and demands an exclusive cast scoop before the end of the day.

scenes.title: Casting Is Just Like Dating
scenes.summary: Ji-yeon lists all the reasons celebrities rejected their show, Joon-mo compares casting to push-and-pull in romance, and Ji-yeon wryly suggests he handle the casting himself.

scenes.title: How About a Matchmaking Concept?
scenes.summary: Put on the spot for an idea, Seung-chan presents a seven-year cycle of hit dating shows, prompting Joon-mo to ask if he attended Seoul National University before sending him to erase a tape.

scenes.title: Eggshells Are Not Food Waste
scenes.summary: At the neighborhood recycling bin, Jum-soon lectures Ye-jin about eggshells and housekeeping until Ye-jin fires back, before Bo-sun pulls his wife away worried about local votes.

scenes.title: Let's Go See the Cherry Blossoms
scenes.summary: In a springtime memory, Ye-jin asks Joon-mo to go see the cherry blossoms before rain knocks them down, and when editing keeps him inside, Joon-mo offers drinks and a karaoke song instead.

scenes.title: Let's Pay It in Installments
scenes.summary: Ye-jin catches Seung-chan painting correction fluid on a tape label instead of erasing the tape, then trades her silence for an installment plan on the car repair bill and a snack errand.

scenes.title: That Matchmaking Idea Sounds Good
scenes.summary: After Tae-ho frets over his daughter's tutoring bills and hears Joon-mo joke about idol agencies, Director Jang shoots down their pitches until he hears and loves the matchmaking concept.

scenes.title: She Is My Daughter
scenes.summary: Visiting top entertainment agencies to cast idols like Hani, Tae-ho asks about free language and fitness classes before sliding over his own daughter's photo as a trainee candidate.

scenes.title: You Can Have Both Work and Love
scenes.summary: Finding Hye-joo crying in the stairwell after Joon-mo ended things, Ye-jin offers awkward comfort that she can succeed at both work and romance, while Seung-chan marvels at the office drama.

scenes.title: Are There No Sausages?
scenes.summary: Ye-jin scolds Seung-chan for buying only literal crackers without sausages or jerky, withholds an extra installment payment, and tells him a variety producer needs comic flair.

scenes.title: Giving Reporter Kang the Hani Scoop
scenes.summary: Amazed that Tae-ho booked Hani so quickly despite online sightings of him pitching his daughter, Joon-mo calls Reporter Kang to hand over the exclusive.

scenes.title: Cindy's Fans Sent This
scenes.summary: In the Music Bank room, Ye-jin scolds Il-yong over earphones and personal parcels only to learn Cindy's fans blacklisted her after their dressing-room clash, while Cindy faces online backlash.

scenes.title: Are You in My Anti-Fan Club?
scenes.summary: In her van, Cindy orders her manager to read harsh online comments aloud without skipping anything, then catches him knowing suspiciously much about her anti-fan forum.

scenes.title: Is Your Wrist All Right?
scenes.summary: After Seung-chan helps push a heavy van in the KBS lot when Ye-jin hurts her wrist, he negotiates her next payment to fifty thousand won and asks whether she has someone to view cherry blossoms with.

scenes.title: Did You Graduate From Seoul National?
scenes.summary: Back with his team, Joon-mo pitches a three-on-three idol couple trip and insists his earlier Seoul National remark to Seung-chan was impressed praise rather than rejection.

scenes.title: You Have to Leave a Small Gap
scenes.summary: Fretting at home over Joon-mo's switched-off phone, Ye-jin gets a lecture from her younger brother Ye-joon on why replying instantly to every text leaves men no room to wonder about her.

scenes.title: Is Your Only Business Really the Umbrella?
scenes.summary: Assuming Seung-chan asked for her number to flirt, Cindy smirks at his late-night text until she realizes he is strictly demanding the KBS lobby umbrella back before nine tomorrow morning.

scenes.title: Caught After Moving Fifty Centimeters
scenes.summary: Hani's agency representative explains to a stunned Joon-mo why Hani must drop out: celebrating a chart win, she fought off three rowdy men with taekwondo and drove fifty centimeters into a sobriety checkpoint.

scenes.title: How About Cindy?
scenes.summary: With the other cast members threatening to pull out unless Hani's replacement is named, Seung-chan timidly suggests Cindy, thrilling the room and getting ordered to call her immediately.

scenes.title: Go Buy Some Sweet Pancakes
scenes.summary: Calling a sleep-deprived Seung-chan to her desk, Ye-jin praises his plucky spirit, hands over her fifty-thousand-won cash installment, and promptly sends him out for ten sweet pancakes.

scenes.title: Casting Is Never Supposed to Be Easy
scenes.summary: Director Jang orders Joon-mo to recruit a top star like Cindy as Hani's replacement; Tae-ho and Jang brag about freezing outdoors to court top hosts before admitting both attempts failed.

scenes.title: I Am the Lowest Junior
scenes.summary: Just as Bo-sun boasts at a snack stall that his producer son commands legions of staff, he spots Seung-chan buying ten pancakes on an errand; Seung-chan then phones Cindy and heads to her rehearsal.
scenes.location: street snack stall and rehearsal hall

scenes.title: These Already Have an Owner
scenes.summary: At Cindy's rehearsal hall, Seung-chan refuses to give her even one sweet pancake because all ten belong to Ye-jin, then earnestly pitches how variety shows win top stars new fans.

scenes.title: It Freezes Sometimes When the Signal Is Weak
scenes.summary: During an overseas video call at a rival agency, the screen mysteriously freezes whenever Joon-mo brings up casting their biggest idol, right before CEO Byun phones him about Seung-chan.

scenes.title: Are You Calling Me Cheap Right Now?
scenes.summary: CEO Byun calculates billions of won in lost concert revenue to reject Seung-chan's offer, only for Seung-chan to call pure profit-chasing lowbrow right before Joon-mo rushes in to haul him away.

scenes.title: What Do You Want to Eat?
scenes.summary: Joon-mo demands Seung-chan choose a meal only to reject noodles, stew, and burgers one after another, before Tae-ho joins them for drinks and teases Joon-mo's weekend-hiking flattery muscle.

scenes.title: I Brought the Sweet Pancakes
scenes.summary: Getting an apology text from Joon-mo, Ye-jin forgets all about playing hard to get and hurries home, only to open the door to a tipsy Seung-chan delivering her ten cold pancakes.

scenes.title: Epilogue: Everyone Knows Except Them
scenes.summary: In an epilogue interview, Ye-jin's former boyfriend recalls how she always put Joon-mo first for cherry blossoms and weekend plans, remarking that everyone can see her feelings except the two of them.
